declared_before: any measurement result, fit, or final render existed
note: Tolerances are fixed here. Changing one later requires a written reason in CHANGELOG and must not be done merely because a check failed.

P1_convergence.what: theta(t), omega(t), E(t) over 0-10 s at >=3 step sizes (or tolerance levels) of the production integrator
P1_convergence.tol: max|theta_h/2 - theta_h/4| < 1e-7 rad; observed convergence order within 0.5 of the theoretical order
P1_convergence.why: 1e-7 rad is ~1e-5 px of bob motion at the reference scale; far below any visible or measurement effect

P2_independent_benchmark.what: independently written solver (verifier, different method, no imports from solver/) vs production trajectory at identical params
P2_independent_benchmark.why: two independent high-accuracy integrations must agree far below measurement noise

P3_finite_amplitude_period.what: conservative case period vs exact elliptic-integral period 4*sqrt(I_eff/(m g d))*K(sin(theta0/2)) (or the formula valid for the declared model) and the small-angle limit as theta0 -> 0
P3_finite_amplitude_period.regime: exact for an undamped rigid pendulum about a fixed frictionless axis; small-angle formula only as theta0 -> 0

P4_energy.what: conservative case total energy drift; damped case energy balance E(t) - E(0) + integral(P_diss dt)
P4_energy.tol: |drift|/E0 < 1e-8 (conservative); |balance residual|/E0 < 1e-7 (damped); dE/dt <= 1e-12*E0 at all samples (no growth)

P5_constraints_saved_blend.what: reopened saved .blend, evaluated world transforms: pivot position, pivot-to-bob-centre length, out-of-plane coordinate, wire endpoints coincide with pin and bob attachment
P5_constraints_saved_blend.tol: pivot drift < 1e-6 m; |L(t) - L_c| < 1e-6 m; |y_bob| < 1e-6 m; wire endpoint gaps < 1e-5 m
P5_constraints_saved_blend.why: float32 transform precision ~1e-7 m at this scale

P6_blend_vs_solver.what: evaluated bob position from the reopened .blend at every frame and 4 subframes per frame vs validated solver
P6_blend_vs_solver.why: cubic Hermite interpolation error estimate ~5e-7 rad at 24 fps; 1e-5 rad is < 0.01 px

P7_tension.what: suspension tension from solver over the clip
P7_tension.tol: T(t) > 0 at all samples (wire stays taut), reported min/max

P8_initial_conditions_time.what: theta(0), omega(0) in solver, bake and .blend equal params; frame n at t=n/24 exactly; no time scaling

P9_control_response.what: changed L (x4), amplitude (2 and 15 deg), damping (x10) re-run through the real build path
P9_control_response.tol: periods and decay envelopes match the formulas of P3 / linear damping theory within 1e-4 relative (or the regime-appropriate formula)

P10_repeatability.tol: identical keyframe arrays (bitwise) and identical evaluated bob positions

reference_fidelity.note: Reported separately from physics validation. The AI reference is not ground truth; failing these does not license nonphysical fixes.
reference_fidelity.R1_tracking_uncertainty: report per-frame bob-centre uncertainty sigma_px from the measurement method

R2_fit_residual.what: projected model bob centre vs tracked bob centre, fit segment t < 7.5 s

R3_heldout.what: prediction on held-out t >= 7.5 s without refit
R3_heldout.target: RMS <= max(3 px, 3*sigma_px); phase error at t=10 s < 0.05 cycle

R4_camera.what: static landmark reprojection after camera calibration

R5_render_track.what: bob centre tracked in the final render vs tracked in the reference, same method

visual_review.V1: No geometry shape change, attachment sliding, length change, flicker, or popping in dense strips at turning points and zero crossings
visual_review.V2: Stand, base, arm, pin, wire and bob present with readable construction; materials read as walnut, steel and polished brass
visual_review.V3: Side-by-side at identical physical times, no retiming; static stand silhouette IoU >= 0.9 vs reference mask (reported)
visual_review.V4: Reviewer distinguishes observed problems, hypotheses and untested claims
